description: Your colleague pushed changes and the CI pipeline is now failing. You've pulled the latest code to /home/ga/workspace/payment_processor which contains a Python payment processing module with pytest tests. Your task is to use VSCode's integrated Test Explorer to run the tests locally and identify what's failing. The project has test files but VSCode's testing features are NOT yet configured - you need to discover and enable the Test Explorer. Specifically: (1) Enable pytest in VSCode (look for Testing features in Command Palette or Activity Bar), (2) Run the tests using the integrated Test Explorer UI (NOT just terminal), (3) Identify which test(s) are failing. The project contains payment.py (main module), tests/test_payment.py (test suite), and pytest.ini (config). You must use VSCode's built-in testing UI to complete this task.
